Communication Studies challenges students to be attentive to communicative behaviors in multiple contexts. Classes are designed to improve message delivery and interpretation in ways that demonstrate critical and analytical thinking. Whether you are interested in finding out how to improve relationships, evaluate information to make informed decisions, or gain media industry experience, the Communication Studies Department is dedicated to teaching students how to be effective professionals.


View information for the Department of Communication Studies, including Learning Objectives for the department and its programs.
